Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Weapons. Is that what you think I am?

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: He's helped every person in this city, and that's what you lead with?

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: He's trying to help us. Stop it.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Thank you.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Somebody had to say it out loud. Thank you.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Get them out. All of them. Even the ones who'd never do the same for me.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: There were synths down there who never chose any of this.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: He made me. He picked which memories I'd get. He picked you.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: And I still want to hold him. How is that fair?

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: Because he's yours too. Whatever that means now.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: I'm not setting foot in that place again unless I have to. Not while he's in charge.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: People helping people. I can get behind that.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: This was the right choice. Out of all of them.

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: It really was.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: They don't even ask what I am. They just ask if I'm safe.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Synths like me get to choose now. Rights. Freedom. Imagine that.

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: She's right. They're good people.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: They'd shoot me on sight if they knew. You know that, right?

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: They're our best chance at finding Shaun.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: A steel hand. Sure. But at what cost?

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: Nobody's touching you. Not while I'm here.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Better you than him. It still hurts, though.

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: For both of us.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: There were good people up there. I still feel safer.

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: A lot of good people.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: The Commonwealth will be better without them.

Speaker: Organic Nora
Text: It will.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: He didn't know either. Thank you for not making him pay for it.

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: He served them his whole life. This is how they repay him.
Delivery: Bitter (Blind Betrayal: execute Danse, Synth Hates)

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: Good job, sweetie.
Delivery: Proud, warm (Human Error: free Amelia Stockton, Synth Loves)

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: You let them keep her. You let them keep testing.
Delivery: Cold (Human Error: side with Dr. Chambers, Synth Hates)

Speaker: Synth Nora
Text: He ran. I'd have run too.
